_twin_stream_comment: Twin's head-cam feed, registered as a second MAIN-VIEW source (viewmodeButton toggles VideoFeed between this and the avatar stream above) -- not a PiP entry. remote_ip is separate from the top-level remote_ip above since twin usually runs on a different host than the avatar (here: twin on this same operator machine, avatar remote). Ports match config/pipeline_config_twin_overlay_local.yaml's head_cam override (avatar's base 5004/5005/5007 + 900) in the simulator repo -- unconditionally applied whenever a process launches with --twin, regardless of where it runs.
